interaction_history.overview: A samurai answers a village's request for protection after he falls on hard times. The town needs protection from bandits, so the samurai gathers six others to help him teach the people how to defend themselves, and the villagers provide the soldiers with food. A giant battle occurs when 40 bandits attack the village.
interaction_history.title: Seven Samurai (The Magnificent Seven) (Shichinin no samurai)

interaction_history.overview: A mentally unstable Vietnam War veteran works as a night-time taxi driver in New York City where the perceived decadence and sleaze feeds his urge for violent action, attempting to save a preadolescent prostitute in the process.
interaction_history.title: Taxi Driver

interaction_history.overview: A small suburban town receives a visit from a castaway unfinished science experiment named Edward.
interaction_history.title: Edward Scissorhands

interaction_history.overview: The true story of British athletes preparing for and competing in the 1924 Summer Olympics.
interaction_history.title: Chariots of Fire

interaction_history.overview: A burger-loving hit man, his philosophical partner, a drug-addled gangster's moll and a washed-up boxer converge in this sprawling, comedic crime caper. Their adventures unfurl in three stories that ingeniously trip back and forth in time.
interaction_history.title: Pulp Fiction

interaction_history.overview: Naive and idealistic Jefferson Smith, leader of the Boy Rangers, is appointed on a lark by the spineless governor of his state. He is reunited with the state's senior senator--presidential hopeful and childhood hero, Senator Joseph Paine. In Washington, however, Smith discovers many of the shortcomings of the political process as his earnest goal of a national boys' camp leads to a conflict with the state political boss, Jim Taylor. Taylor first tries to corrupt Smith and then later attempts to destroy Smith through a scandal.
interaction_history.title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington

interaction_history.overview: This acclaimed thriller stars Jane Fonda as Bree Daniel, a New York City call girl who becomes enmeshed in an investigation into the disappearance of a business executive. Detective John Klute is hired to follow Daniel, and eventually begins a romance with her, but it appears that he hasn't been the only person on her trail. When it becomes clear that Daniel is being targeted, it's up to her and Klute to figure out who is after her before it's too late.
interaction_history.title: Klute

interaction_history.overview: Newspaper magnate, Charles Foster Kane is taken from his mother as a boy and made the ward of a rich industrialist. As a result, every well-meaning, tyrannical or self-destructive move he makes for the rest of his life appears in some way to be a reaction to that deeply wounding event.
interaction_history.title: Citizen Kane

interaction_history.overview: A boy and his brother don't get along well. In order to let their ill mother rest, they are separated and sent to different relatives.
interaction_history.title: My Life as a Dog (Mitt liv som hund)

interaction_history.overview: The real-life struggle of an honest New York City cop against a corrupt system.
interaction_history.title: Serpico
